cistern.speaker: narrator
cistern.text: The cistern route. Crew Marrow, all four, standing waist-deep in Weft-lit water, singing in a fifth with their eyes open. They are alive. They do not turn around.

choices.text: [Rootkin] The water is Weft-lit. I can feel what they are singing to, and it is not the Choir. Pull them out.
Pull them out. All of them.
Yev, what are they singing to?

hears.speaker: yev
hears.text: Not the Choir. What the Choir sings to. They are further in than the Choir is, and they do not know it.
